objective: Prepare and execute exactly one output-blind, structurally distinct W4A8 software-reference candidate using row-local block-16 affine four-bit weights with BF16 offset/step metadata, the frozen source-relative V2 matrix, a candidate-local arbitrary-text and multi-turn chat path, deterministic replay, honest software latency, exact byte accounting, and Fresh Reviewer adjudication.

benchmark_contract.public_module_contract: The existing ace2_shell parameters and ports remain unchanged. This specification-stage software-reference attempt does not generate or modify RTL.

terminal_predecessor.routing_constraint: Do not encode, search for, or tune against the predecessor's failed response text or case-specific observable. The predecessor remains immutable terminal evidence.

source_model.embedding_rule: Preserve the source BF16 embedding parameter object, storage, and bytes. Detach lm_head storage before quantizing any Linear weight.

output_blind_selection_evidence.selection_limit: Source weights and byte geometry only. No prompt, token, decoded output, response action, case-specific rubric, hidden harness, or golden output informed the layout selection. Weight SSE is a pre-execution construction discriminator, not a product-quality conclusion.

representation.block_order: Linear-module order from model.named_modules(), then output row, contiguous input block, and input lane
representation.payload: one unsigned four-bit affine code in [0,15] per Linear weight; two codes per byte; earlier flat weight in the low nibble
representation.metadata: one little-endian raw IEEE-754 BF16 offset record followed by one little-endian raw IEEE-754 BF16 step record per row-local 16-weight block
representation.metadata_legal_values: offset must be finite; step must be finite and nonnegative; a nonconstant block requires strictly positive step; NaN and infinity are forbidden
representation.construction: For each source BF16 block, set offset to the exact BF16 block minimum. Compute (FP32 maximum - FP32 offset)/15 in FP32 and round it to BF16 using round-to-nearest ties-to-even. A constant block uses +0 BF16 step and all-zero codes. For a nonconstant block, a zero or non-finite rounded step is a preflight failure. Compute codes by FP32 division using the stored BF16 offset and step, round to nearest ties to even, then clamp to [0,15].
representation.executable_decode: Convert the stored BF16 offset and step to FP32, compute offset + uint4_code * step in FP32, and round once to BF16 using round-to-nearest ties-to-even before model execution. Accelerator RTL may use an integer-equivalent implementation but must reproduce the exact BF16 reconstruction bits; Verilog real arithmetic is forbidden.

memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.payload_stream: contiguous row-major packed nibbles with no per-row padding; stream base and total length are 16-byte aligned
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.metadata_stream: contiguous offset_u16_le,step_u16_le pairs with no per-block or per-row padding; stream base and total length are 16-byte aligned
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.row_geometry: All observed Linear input widths are divisible by 64. Four consecutive 16-weight blocks consume 32 payload bytes plus 16 metadata bytes, exactly 48 bytes or three 128-bit beats for 64 weights.
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.specified_streaming_rate: Three 128-bit reads per 64 weights, averaging 21.333333333333332 weights per read cycle if every read is accepted. This is byte-traffic arithmetic, not measured RTL throughput or latency.
memory_and_accelerator_facing_contract.later_agreement_gate: Before any accelerator policy can be accepted, the software reference and accelerator package must bind identical payload and metadata stream hashes, identical decoded BF16 Linear-weight hashes for all 169 tensors, and cycle-accurate per-command token/output agreement. This plan does not open RTL work.

activation_policy.policy: inherited authenticated grouped Dynamic Scale32 activation quantization

matrix_and_delivery.delivered_answer_rule: Every allowed visible answer is the exact decoded output produced by this executable quantized reference.

candidate_local_chat_contract.execution_boundary: The command is candidate-local and may be used only after runner/plan hashes are frozen. Its outputs may not be used to repair this candidate. The live tools/ace2_chat_demo.py path remains unmodified until Fresh Reviewer acceptance and Manager routing.
